action.question: How should we stop perm-gate from prompting on gh commands?

questions.question: How should we stop perm-gate from prompting on gh commands?

options.label: Strip HEREDOCs/quoted bodies before matching (Recommended)
options.description: Fix the real bug: ASK_PATTERNS should only inspect the command head, not user-supplied body content. Fixes gh issue edit/create AND git commit -m "..." false positives. Small change in extract_subject / a new matching helper.

options.label: Broaden the gh allow-pattern
options.description: Add create|edit|comment|close|reopen|item-add|item-create to the gh static-allow line. Narrower fix; doesn't help git commit -m bodies; still risks letting through a 'gh issue create' with a dangerous chained command.

options.label: Short-circuit: trust the user allow-list for gh
options.description: If Bash(gh *) is in the user's allow-list and DENY doesn't fire, skip the ASK check for gh. Quickest fix; reduces the gate's value (a chained 'gh ... && rm -rf' wouldn't be caught by ASK).

options.label: Just disable the gate for this session
options.description: Set PERM_GATE_ENFORCE=0 in the hook (or comment out the hook). Fastest, but loses the rm-rf/-style protections globally.

transcript_tail.text: lets allow all gh commands, why are you asking again? is it our new sec/hook schema?

`gh *` is already in your allow list (line 13). The reason you're still being asked is the **PreToolUse perm-gate hook** (line 67) — it runs AFTER the allow-list check and applies its own static rules. Let me check what it does with `gh`.
Let me check the decisions log to see what `gh` command was just gated.
Found it. The decisions log shows two distinct problems:

Diagnosis — your settings *do* already allow `Bash(gh *)`. The prompts come from the global **perm-gate PreToolUse hook** (`~/.claude/settings.json:67`), and there are actually two distinct things going on:

**1. The narrow `gh` allow-pattern (perm_gate.py:119)**
```python
r"^(gh\s+(pr|issue|project)\s+(view|list|status))\b",
```
Only `gh pr|issue|project view|list|status` is auto-allowed. Anything else (`create`, `edit`, `item-add`, `auth`, `api`, …) gets no static verdict → with `PERM_GATE_ENFORCE_AI=0` the gate returns no decision and *should* fall through to your `Bash(gh *)` allow-list (so e.g. `gh project item-add` is logged as ASK but the hook emits None — not actually prompting you).

**2. The real culprit: ASK patterns match the issue body text, not just the command**
The recent log shows `gh issue edit 18 ...` and `gh issue create ...` being bound to **static-ask**. Subjects are matched as one big string, so a `--body "$(cat <<'EOF' …"` payload that happens to contain `.env`, `deploy`, `merge`, `push`, `sudo`, etc. trips ASK_PATTERNS. Your secret-rotation tickets are full of those words → every `gh issue edit/create` prompts. Same bug would hit `git commit -m "fix .env loading"`.

So this isn't really "the new hook schema asking about gh" — it's **ASK patterns leaking into user-supplied prose**.

What do you want to do?
